trap.label: subject × matter
trap.wrong: My favourite matter at school was history.
trap.right: My favourite subject at school was history.
trap.why: Em português “matéria” é a disciplina escolar. Em inglês, matter significa assunto/questão ou matéria física; a disciplina é subject.

mcq.q: Support that is withdrawn gradually is...
Teaching in different ways for different learners:

fix.wrong: The teacher did a prove at the end.
fix.right: The teacher gave a test at the end.

fix.wrong: Formative assessments is useful for pupils.
fix.right: Formative assessments are useful for pupils.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com subject: “My favourite matter is math.”
Reescreva no plural: “A summative assessment is final.”
Reescreva com gradually: “Support is removed bit by bit.”
